name: Manga-Colorizer AlacGAN mobile preview
input: float32 NHWC [1,H,W,5]: grayscale [0,1], four zero hint channels; H/W multiples of 32
output: float32 NCHW [1,3,H,W]: RGB [-1,1]; interleave before compositing
conversion: preserve dynamic H/W; do not pass a fixed inputShape to converter
sizing: aspect fit: short edge <=512, long edge <=768; pad to multiple of 32, min64; no upscaling
compositing: restore original high-frequency grayscale detail and black ink; allow white regions to receive color; explicit RGBA source buffer
